how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted only online. Candidates should note the following steps and instructions:
Visit the official NIOT recruitment portal: niot.res.in/recruitment_details.php.
Fill the application form online and upload a recent colour passport-size photograph.
Upload the required scanned documents (listed below).
Submit the completed application to generate an online application number.
Download and retain a copy of the generated application, which contains both the registration number and application number.

content_sections.heading: NIOT Technician Important Dates 2026
content_sections.text: The notification specifies the closing date for the NIOT Technician Apply Online process. The application start date is not specified in the notification.

content_sections.heading: NIOT Technician Vacancy 2026 Details
content_sections.text: NIOT has notified a single vacancy under the Technician discipline of Electronics / Instrumentation, categorized as Unreserved (UR).

content_sections.heading: NIOT Technician Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the following essential qualification for the NIOT Technician post: 10th Class Pass (Secondary / Matric) from a recognized Board ITI course in Electronics / Instrumentation approved by the National Council for Vocational Training (NCVT) or equivalent from a recognized institution Basic knowledge of computers Desirable: Two years of experience in the relevant field related to the job requirements is desirable but not mandatory. The upper age limit for NIOT Technician Recruitment 2026 is not exceeding 25 years, reckoned as on the closing date for online application. As the post is earmarked Unreserved, no age relaxation is available to SC/ST/OBC candidates. However, age relaxation is applicable for Government servants, Ex-servicemen, and Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) as per Central Government orders in force from time to time.

content_sections.heading: NIOT Technician Recruitment 2026 - Job Requirements
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be responsible for the following duties: Industrial panel wiring and interfacing, PCB soldering and assembly, handling of electronic instruments, assembly, testing and calibration of instruments/sensors, interfacing and panel wiring, and installation of electronic systems on board ships and offshore installations. Field testing of systems/equipment developed by NIOT onboard designated ships or platforms at sea. Wiring of DAC systems, and assembly, integration and maintenance of DAC system sub-components, electronic instruments and equipment. Pressure testing of underwater sensors and equipment. Maintenance of power supply and instrumentation lab equipment. Participation in sea trials, offshore system deployments, and survey and exploration at sea.

content_sections.heading: NIOT Technician Recruitment 2026 - Salary
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be placed at Pay Level-2 (Rs. 19,900–63,200) in the Pay Matrix as per the 7th Central Pay Commission (VII CPC), under Group 'C', along with allowances as admissible under VII CPC.

content_sections.heading: NIOT Technician Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for the NIOT Technician post involves two stages: Trade / Written Test: Final selection is based purely on the order of merit in the trade/written test marks, among candidates who qualify the skill test. Skill Test: A practical test of qualifying nature. Candidates must secure the minimum cut-off mark fixed by the Selection Committee to qualify. Both the trade/written test and skill test will be conducted at NIOT, Chennai, either on the same day or on consecutive days. The syllabus, scheme of test, and schedule will be published on the NIOT website. Candidates must make their own arrangements for travel and stay, and no TA will be paid, except outstation SC/ST candidates, who will be reimbursed sleeper-class rail fare by the shortest route on production of tickets. Before the test stage, applications go through a preliminary screening based on essential qualification, date of birth (after applicable age relaxation), completeness of the application and uploaded documents, and desirable experience. NIOT may further shortlist candidates for the test through cut-off marks, experience criteria, or a written test if the number of applications is large.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIOT Technician Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted only online. Candidates should note the following steps and instructions: Visit the official NIOT recruitment portal: niot.res.in/recruitment_details.php . Fill the application form online and upload a recent colour passport-size photograph. Upload the required scanned documents (listed below). Submit the completed application to generate an online application number. Download and retain a copy of the generated application, which contains both the registration number and application number. Hardcopy applications will not be entertained. Requests for change or correction in the submitted application form will not be entertained under any circumstances, so candidates must verify all data and documents before final submission. Candidates without a proper application number will not be permitted to attend the selection process, and incomplete applications will be treated as invalid and rejected. faq.question: Q1. What is NIOT Technician Grade-A Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the National Institute of Ocean Technology (NIOT), Ministry of Earth Sciences, for one Technician Grade-A (Electronics / Instrumentation) post under Advertisement No. NIOT/E&P/05/2026 (Regular).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is 1 (one) vacancy, categorized as Unreserved (UR).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the online application is 14 September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must be 10th pass and hold an ITI in Electronics/Instrumentation approved by NCVT or equivalent, along with basic computer knowledge. Two years of relevant experience is desirable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 25 years as on the closing date, with no relaxation for SC/ST/OBC since the post is Unreserved. Relaxation applies for Govt. servants, Ex-servicemen, and PwBD as per Central Government rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The application fee is not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply only online via niot.res.in/recruitment_details.php, by filling the form and uploading the required photograph and documents.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection involves a trade/written test and a skill test. The skill test is qualifying in nature, and final merit is based only on trade/written test marks among those who qualify the skill test.
